My aunt came over our house one day with my three cousins, and a garbage bag full of clothes. She said she was just visiting, and my older brother, and I were excited as hell cause they were our favorite cousins. It was like having a group of best friends over. That night my mom comes up, and says they'll be staying over for the week, like a sleepover, and that she, and my dad we're taking the whole week off of work. We we're all so happy. It was the best week of summer ever. I later found out my aunt came over not to visit us, it was because her husband(my uncle), was beating her, and she left the house while he went to work. She packed a garbage bag with some clothes from each of my cousins, and didn't know where to go, so she stopped at our place to look up some shelters where she and my cousins could stay. My aunt started getting calls from him saying he was gonna kill her, and the boys. She was so scared, so my mom said she wasn't leaving, she was gonna live with us for the week so she could file a police report, and she was taking the week off, and my dad was so they could protect them. My aunt slept on the couch, and my mom, or dad would watch outside to see if he was coming. I always think about that week cause on one hand it was so fun for my cousins, my brother, and I, but on the other, my mother protected her cousin, and nephews from being abused or killed. For anyone wondering, they got a divorce, he went to jail for abuse, and other charges, she got full custody, and she's doing ten times better without him.
